deploy.startCommand: /bin/sh -c "(while sleep 300; do find / /app/omnivoice_data -xdev -type f -size +64k 2>/dev/null | while read -r f; do dd if=$f iflag=nocache count=0 status=none 2>/dev/null; done; done) & exec python3 -m uvicorn backend.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3900"

OMNIVOICE_API_KEY.description: Admin key - the web UI asks for it once; also the Bearer token for the API

HF_TOKEN.description: Optional Hugging Face token, for gated models and faster downloads

OMP_NUM_THREADS.description: CPU threads for inference - match your plan's vCPUs (Hobby 8, Pro up to 32). Without it PyTorch oversubscribes and stalls

MKL_NUM_THREADS.description: Same thread cap for the math library - leave as is

PORT.description: Port Railway routes to - leave as is
